approval.scope: Intermediate G2 history allowance only: >=30% lower retained heap, <=10% total elapsed/CPU overhead, <=30s individual save or cold revert; final G4 unchanged.

independence_unit: fresh installed-package journey process tree and project for each independent replicate
pairing_block: same recipe seed/settings/dependencies/host/boundary; original control and treatment each fresh, serial
member_order: alternate control/candidate then candidate/control by block index; no prewarming outside boundary
paired_summary: geometric mean of within-block candidate/control ratios (mean log ratios); no pooling shapes or routes

uncertainty_method.method: paired log-ratio Student-t one-sided upper confidence bound
uncertainty_method.assumptions: independent blocks; approximately normal block log ratios; retain raw pairs; obvious violations hold instead of switching estimator

decision_rule: all required point and upper-bound ratios must meet their thresholds, with science/files/limits valid; point miss fails, uncertainty-only miss holds
borderline_rule: point threshold met but upper confidence bound exceeds threshold -> held; no extra favorable reruns
non_regression_rule: G4: candidate/matched immediate accepted comparator <=1.00 for both point and upper-bound elapsed and combined peak; no margin. The standalone G2 history experiment uses its explicitly approved 1.10 elapsed/CPU ceilings; that allowance is not GUI or consumer-wide acceptance.

combined_peak_definition.membership: GUI process, reusable worker if adopted, driver and descendants under one service
combined_peak_definition.interval: process startup through all required outputs/acknowledgement and teardown
combined_peak_definition.shared_memory: charged once by cgroup accounting; do not add RSS
combined_peak_definition.file_cache: include cache and kernel charges reported by same cgroup; separate host page-cache condition recorded
combined_peak_definition.exclusions: fixture generation and independent output oracle excluded from timed service; their own preflight accounted separately

g2.retained_heap_measurement: unique live R allocations across all owners after standardized GC, excluding freed objects; never sum object.size across aliases
g2.scope: qualified history workloads; capacity-only failures excluded from finite-ratio acceptance

g4.required: complete independent IQ then real Limpa journey; startup, full-history legacy RDS, copies, automatic outputs and included restore boundary

retry_rule: one replacement only for independently documented infrastructure-invalid block, preserving failed receipt; no retry of valid unfavorable outcomes

correction_budget.requires: measured attribution, scoped owner, new build ID; rerun only invalidated evidence

invalid_baseline_rule: OOM/timeout/missing science or outputs cannot be a finite denominator; capacity-only observations labeled separately
missing_metric_rule: required absent/nonfinite metrics -> held; never zero, impute or omit

boundaries.baseline: DIA-003 binds original browser actions and required-file inventory before timing
boundaries.histories: include initial save and realistic forward/revert/reset/reapply; include full export separately and in composed sequence
boundaries.consumers: resident vs full RDS vs small saved product vs selective read; creation cost and misses included
boundaries.cold_state: fresh process, empty optional cache, disjoint project; filesystem cache condition explicitly paired, not asserted cold from restart alone

iq.status: protocol frozen; installed control and G0 qualification still required
